items.text: 49ers WR De’Zhaun Stribling opts for surgery on deltoid rupture/ankle; back late November/early December (~10 weeks).
items.why: Deltoid rupture repair for complete recovery
items.implication: Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson primary beneficiaries

items.text: Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday, but expects to play Sunday at Houston. Got mental reps.
Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans to place on IR.
items.implication: Drew Lock or other likely to start; stream options

items.text: Ladd McConkey (rib) will not practice Wednesday; day-to-day after leaving early Week 1. Negative early sign.
items.implication: Status uncertain for Week 2; Tre Harris primary beneficiary

items.text: Ravens placing rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games to quicken recovery.
items.implication: Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore elevated roles; Flowers also dinged

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3, but same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year. Scary history; Raiders cautious, DNP Wednesday, day-to-day.
items.why: Meniscus trim; team felt could have played W1 if needed but cautious
items.implication: Monitor practice; Michael Mayer continues as starter if out

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant in Wednesday practice; indication he could return Sunday.
items.implication: Potential lead back return; monitor for active

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor; J.K. Dobbins or others could benefit if limited

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for season after surgery for torn MCL; placed on IR, Jack Stoll signed.

Travis Hunter played only four specialized offensive snaps in Week 1 (jet sweep, screens, decoy) with zero routes past LOS. Jaguars actions (Meyers extension, not trading BTJ) confirm limited offensive intention.
items.why: Clear specialized package matching offseason signals
items.implication: Limited fantasy upside on offense short-term

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid 49ers WR injuries (Stribling).

Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, ran 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse role confirmed.
items.why: Massive opportunity share as expected in KC

items.text: Ashton Jeanty upgrades to high-end RB1 after dominating Week 1 (73% snaps, 70% rushes, 21% targets, 99 Util score). Endorsed via Fantasy Life utilization. Etienne downgraded in murky Saints committee.
items.why: Elite utilization and efficiency for Jeanty; Etienne 43% attempts/38% routes despite snaps
items.implication: Jeanty every-down RB1; Etienne low-end RB2 hold with caution

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played a horrific game. Opportunity was elite.
items.why: High xFP despite poor actual output
